FASTVC-BENCH-CORPUS:chromium-main-v1-943b94ae-1c74-4335-94fa-ceb4d277cea8
 
Test that entering fullscreen with user gesture will remove gesture requirement for media playback.

EVENT(canplaythrough)
* No user gesture initiated
RUN(video.play())
* Click button to enter fullscreen
RUN(video.webkitEnterFullScreen())
* User gesture initiated
RUN(video.play())
EVENT(playing)
END OF TEST
